messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - customer 'Silica' (VPC / dedicated-pool: silica-prod-pool) experiencing >20% 429s for generation routes. Severity: customer-impact. Pager sent to #incidents and @oncall-sre.

maria-cs: FYI Silica just pinged support — production token denial. They say it's intermittent but started ~8:02 PDT. They're on a reserved dedicated pool and are hitting 429s across multiple endpoints.

oncall-sre: taking this. initial checks: looking at pool metrics now.

oncall-sre: metrics: sustained 429 rate ~27% over 6m for pool silica-prod-pool, increase in request volume + sudden spike in concurrent sessions from a single tenant API key. No errors in infra hosts yet, backend healthy. (link to dashboard)

oncall-sre: suspect quota enforcement misapplied — there was a recent quota change for enterprise customers rolled last night.

raja-eng: quick question — do we have per-tenant rate limits on the dedicated pool enforced by the control plane, or is this an edge proxy rule?

lina-platform: control plane enforces token-level quotas for dedicated pools via rate-limiter service RL-svc. last deploy to RL-svc 1845640000 (small fix). Could be config + TTL mismatch.

sam-ops: can we temporarily create an emergency override (contract-level) to unblock until we root-cause? I'm +1 to a very short lift with audit.

oncall-sre: agree. propose: emergency override for tenant silica: bump allowed qps by 2x, duration 30m, and enable host-level fallback routing to hosted tier for 10% of traffic. This gives immediate relief while we investigate.

eve-manager: need CS sign-off for the customer notification and legal guardrails — maria, can you confirm Silica is ok with temporary lift?

maria-cs: already on call with them. They're seeing user-facing errors; they asked for immediate mitigation. They accept temporary lift and will document impact for audit.

oncall-sre: executing plan. issuing emergency override now.

cloud-admin-bot: Executing admin action: create_override --tenant silica --scope qps --factor 2 --ttl 1800 --reason "Emergency: production 429s" --author oncall-sre

cloud-admin-bot: Result: OK. Override id: OV-2026-8712. Effective immediately.

oncall-sre: enabled fallback routing for 10% sample by request-id for 30m: `route-sample --tenant silica --target hosted-tier --percent 10 --ttl 1800`

raja-eng: checking application logs for the tenant after override — I'm seeing the 429 spikes drop from 27% to ~3% within ~90s. KV cache warmup for sessions improved. Good sign.

sam-ops: observability note: logging the override and tagging all metrics with OV-2026-8712 for postmortem. Also creating a short-lived dashboard to track qps/429s/latency.

maria-cs: I told Silica support the mitigation is in place and they confirm traffic looks better from their side. They want ETA on root cause and next steps.

oncall-sre: immediate next steps: 1) validate RL-svc config and recent deploy (raja+lina), 2) check token-level quota table for TTL mismatches (lina), 3) verify whether single API key misbehaved or if traffic pattern changed (maria + raja). Will update in 15m.

lina-platform: RL-svc config: found an override rule that accidentally applied a stricter global cap when tenant-specific row was missing due to migration script last night. Migration created temp rows but a race left silica without explicit per-tenant row for ~12m — control plane fell back to global cap. Oops.

raja-eng: reproduction: ran migration locally and saw same window where tenant row was absent during table swap. Fix: change migration to upsert in place and add a pre-check for missing rows. I can push a patch but prefer to do canary today.

sam-ops: action: keep emergency override until permanent fix deployed and validated. recommend extend to 2h but with stricter audit.

eve-manager: prioritize customer SLA and risk — extend to 2h now, but we must notify Finance/Legal since overrides affect billing. maria, loop them in.

maria-cs: looping finance and legal. emailing finance@redwood and legal@redwood with OV-2026-8712 details.

oncall-sre: extending override TTL to 7200s.

cloud-admin-bot: Executing admin action: extend_override --id OV-2026-8712 --ttl 7200 --author oncall-sre

cloud-admin-bot: Result: OK. New expiry in 2 hours.

raja-eng: pushing migration fix to canary branch. Patch: ensure `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` semantics + preflight check script `check-tenant-rows.sh` added. Deploying to canary now.

lina-platform: rolling RL-svc canary with migration fix to one region. Monitoring for error increase.

raja-eng: canary looks green for 10m. no regressions. Scheduling global roll in 30m.

oncall-sre: plan for handoff: I'll be handing to morning oncall at 06:30 local; handoff notes: override OV-2026-8712 in place, migration fix merged to canary and scheduled for global roll in 30m, follow-up ticket INC-1347 created, CS/Finance/Legal notified.

eve-manager: please add clear rollback plan and owner for postmortem. owner: raja-eng.

oncall-sre: added to ticket: owner=raga? (typo) sorry owner=raja-eng. rollback: remove migration and revert RL-svc to previous config; remove override if regressions.

maria-cs: Silica asked for meeting — scheduling 30m postmortem with them after fix confirmed.

sam-ops: created monitor alert: if 429 >5% for 5m in silica-prod-pool, escalate to P1 and auto-notify oncall.

lina-platform: global roll complete. RL-svc updated, migration fix applied. Verifying tenant rows now: silica tenant row present and stable.

raja-eng: post-change check: 429s remain <2% for 20m, latency nominal. marking incident as mitigated.

oncall-sre: handing off final state to morning oncall: all mitigations in place, override expires in 1h20m (can be removed earlier once we confirm billing & postmortem). Follow-up ticket INC-1347 + postmortem assigned to raja-eng.

maria-cs: Silica confirmed customers are no longer seeing errors and appreciates the quick response. They'll join postmortem.

eve-manager: thanks team. please ensure postmortem includes: timeline, root cause (migration race), why tenant fallback didn't catch it, corrective actions (migration upsert, preflight), and billing/contract implications for the override.

oncall-sre: noted. closing the Slack thread for active updates — will post final PM notes in INC-1347 and #postmortems. :thumbsup:
